content: In eleven days, Anthropic's Claude generated the first end-to-end, computer-verifiable formal proof of Fermat's Last Theorem, led by Tsinghua alumnus Tianyi Peng. The project produced approximately 13 million lines of Lean 4 code and over 30,000 intermediate lemmas, resulting in a codebase five times larger than Mathlib. Translating human-readable logic into machine-checkable form required multi-agent coordination via the Prove2Me platform to resolve complexities, while humans provided only minimal high-level guidance throughout the process.

content: The U.S. Commerce Department announced that Secretary Howard Lutnick will review Pentagon contracts involving companies affiliated with the investment firm Cerberus Capital Management. This action aims to address potential conflicts of interest, following scrutiny of Cerberus's holdings in defense-related firms. The review will assess whether these transactions comply with federal procurement regulations and ensure the integrity of government defense spending. Lutnick's office will determine if any contracts require modification or termination to prevent improper influence on federal purchasing decisions.
